newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed slightly down by 0.10 percent in thin trade. The 31-share index closed at 451.24 points, down from 451.67 on Friday.
Total volume was 378,241 dinars against 2.37 million dinars over the previous session.
Banque de l'Habitat fell 0.55 dinar to 15 dinars.
Airline Tunis Air was down 0.4 dinar to 23 dinars with 3,728 shares changing hands.
Banque de Tunisie et des Emirats d'Investissement eased 0.2 dinar to 21.6 dinars.
Tunisie Leasing declined 0.1 dinar to 30.76 dinars. ($1=1.1275 dinar)
